The '''Scorched Power Crystal''' is a {{Legendary}} item that is a {{Odds|Rare}} drop from the [[Inferno Demonlord]] at {{SlayerTier|III}} or higher. It can be used to power [[Beacon|Beacons]] for 48 hours. 

== Obtaining ==
The '''Scorched Power Crystal''' can rarely drop from {{Stier|3}} or higher [[Inferno Demonlord|Inferno Demonlords]] if the player has {{Coll|Blaze Slayer LVL 4}}.

;Drop Chances
*{{Stier|III}}: {{Green|3.24%}} ({{Green|1/30.83}})
*{{Stier|IV}}: {{Green|3.05%}} ({{Green|1/32.81}})

== Usage ==
The '''Scorched Power Crystal''' can be used to power Beacons. Beacons powered by Scorched Power Crystals will give {{Green|1%}} more [[Minions|Minion Speed]] and {{Green|20%}} more of the beacon's active [[Stats|stat]] as compared to usage with the [[Power Crystal]].

== Trivia ==
* The '''Scorched Power Crystal''' can be used even without {{coll|Blaze Slayer 4}}.
